messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR #8124 is ready for merge but CI is flaking on the integration test suite. I need a rebase slot and a merge window that won't collide with the deploy freeze this afternoon. pinging @eng-releases and @oncall :wave:

kevin: Which tests are failing? unit or integration?

maria: integration: `payments_flow_integration_test` — failing intermittently on the sandbox teardown. Logs show timeout in step 7.

sam: @maria can you paste the failing snippet?

maria: ```
# snippet from ci
ERROR: Timeout waiting for sandbox teardown (30s)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/integration/payments_test.py", line 412, in teardown
    self.sandbox.cleanup(timeout=30)
TimeoutError: sandbox did not exit
```

jenna: :eyes: iirc there's a recent change in the sandbox lifecyle that added an extra docker cleanup step. Might be related.

oliver: We should avoid merging during the 15:00-16:00 UTC deploy freeze window — infra will be running DB migrations then. If CI flakes, it could block other merges.

maria: Agreed. My ask: reserve a rebase slot at 16:30 UTC (post-freeze). I'll re-run CI after rebasing onto main. Can someone approve readiness now so I can queue it?

kevin: I can do a quick review for the remaining comments now. If you rebase and CI passes, i'll approve and you can merge after 16:30.

sam: 👍 I'll watch the CI runs and escalate if we see persistent flakes. If it keeps failing, we may need to add a short test skip with an issue link.

release-bot: CI status for PR #8124: latest run failed — payments_flow_integration_test (job 457) — rerun available.

maria: Thanks. I'm going to rebase onto main, run a local flakiness loop for the sandbox, then push. If local loop is OK I'll re-trigger CI.

jenna: If you want me to review the sandbox cleanup code, ping me after rebase. I can help debug the teardown race.

maria: Will do. Plan: rebase at 16:15 UTC, push, rerun CI; @kevin if green, approve; merge at 16:35 UTC (post-freeze). If CI flakes again, we hold and open a quick rollback hotfix branch instead.

oliver: Sounds good. Please add a short note in the PR describing the merge timing plan and link this thread. Keeps the release coordinators aware.

maria: Added note to PR and tagged @eng-releases. Also added the local flakiness log to artifacts.

kevin: Reviewing now. Two tiny nits, then LGTM.

sam: I'll be near CI console at 16:30. If anything looks unstable i'll drop a message here and notify @oncall.

maria: Thanks all — will update with timestamps. :thumbsup:

(10m later)

maria: Rebased and pushed at 16:18 UTC, triggered CI rerun.

release-bot: CI status for PR #8124: running — job 458 (integration).

(40m later)

release-bot: CI status for PR #8124: succeeded — all checks passed.

kevin: Approved and added merge label.

maria: Merged at 16:36 UTC. No post-merge incidents observed. Closing the loop — thanks everyone! :tada:
